configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: The suite as it is normally run. Every case is expected green here; a sanitizer-sensitive case passes without proving anything.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: What the CI build job compiles on macOS, Windows and Linux.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Names a dangling read rather than leaving it to be inferred - a worker reading an execution that has been destroyed. Its silence is not an acquittal for a data race: ASan faults only when a read actually lands after the free.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Where the queue's threading defects are visible. queueing_during_a_batch_runs_every_action_exactly_once passes on every other preset and proves nothing there; a drain that walks the shared action list aborts here.
